_comment: DESKTOP-ARCADE (2P stand-up) only - merged on top of mame-controls.json by tools/Set-MameControls.ps1. The Tron stick is the Xinmotek controller (USB 16C0:05E1): MAME 0.251 lists it as joystick #8 (pinned below with mapdevice, so the number stays if Windows reorders the controllers). Its base is turned 90 degrees (James, 2026-11-27); the Panel Test captured what each push sends: up = X right, right = Y down, down = X left, left = Y up. The trigger is its button 13. Ports from MAME 0.251 itself (tron, -autoboot_script dump of manager.machine.ioport, 2026-11-27). Every input keeps the panel's P1 key as well.

tron.about: the Tron stick moves (turned 90 degrees on this cabinet), its trigger fires; the P1 stick and button 1 still work
